answer: Sybil resistance arises because each identity posts bonded collateral, while correlated equivocation across k coordinated identities triggers a quadratic penalty, O(k^2), rather than k independent fines. Detection also applies an exponential capital-loss multiplier to the controlling escrow, making large swarms economically fatal; asymmetric depreciation prevents recovery from residual value. Thus tundra, lotus, or nebula aliases do not dilute accountability.
